verdicts.evidence: The existsSync guard is redundant: the surrounding try already absorbs the read failure and returns null. Measured corpusStamp over 13 fixtures — absent corpus.json, absent directory entirely, corpus.json as a directory, empty file, UTF-8 BOM, malformed JSON, non-object, null, missing name, missing version, non-string name, UTF-8 name with accents and emoji, and a well-formed stamp — with byte-identical results before and after.

verdicts.evidence: "" is not a valid Node encoding, so readFileSync returns a Buffer instead of throwing, and JSON.parse stringifies that Buffer as UTF-8 — the same bytes 'utf8' would have produced. Verified directly (readFileSync(path, "") returned a Buffer whose String() is the file text) and measured corpusStamp byte-identical over the same 13 fixtures, including a name containing accents and an emoji.
